title: A Machines-on-Machines-shaped reference fixture in core tests (MoM stays dedicated)
description:
Outcome: Machines on Machines is the design reference for the publication layout but stays a dedicated site with its own repository and hooks for now (owner decision 13). Core gets a fictional fixture tenant with MoM's structure (sections, home includes, cards) and a made-up brand, used by golden renders and the browser matrix, so the publication preset is tested without MoM's data or code and without MoM becoming a tenant. A second fixture uses TI's structure.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): new fixtures under features_backend/fixtures/ or tests (SiteConfig + BrandPack + sample content), the golden render suite (PPY-e59af0), the browser matrix (PPY-a526ee).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/reference-layout-fixture.feature):
Scenario: The publication preset renders the reference fixture
    Given the MoM-shaped fixture with a fictional brand
    When the golden renders run
    Then they match the accepted renders and no MoM file is read

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-1252ce. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-e59af0.

Testing: Golden renders.
Rollout: Tests only.
Risk and mitigation: Low. Risk: the fixture drifts from MoM. Mitigation: MoM's own parity check compares its pages with the preset when it adopts it (PPY-31efef).

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
